raw_segments.text: You, I said, who are their legislator, having selected the men, will now select the women
and give them to them—they must be as far as possible of like natures with them, and
they must live in common houses and meet at common meals. None of them will have anything
specially his or her own—they will be together, and will be brought up together, and will
associate at gymnastic exercises. And so they will be drawn by a necessity of their natures
to have intercourse with each other—necessity is not too strong a word, I think.
You, I said, who are their legislator, having selected the men, will now select the women and give them to them.
They must be as far as possible of like natures with them, and they must live in common houses and meet at common meals.
None of them will have anything specially his or her own.
They will be together and will be brought up together and will associate at gymnastic exercises.
And so they will be drawn by a necessity of their natures to have intercourse with each other.
Necessity is not too strong a word, I think.
